description: Balanced profile for daily fullstack work. Uses Mid tier for most agents, High tier for production-risk decisions, and Flash for routing/scheduling.

dispatcher.reason: Cheapest — pure routing, no reasoning needed.

architect.reason: Mid — design, tradeoffs, and design.md need solid reasoning.

planner.reason: Mid — implementation planning and task decomposition.

plan-reviewer.reason: High — strict plan validation and parallel-safety review.

reviewer.reason: High — verification summary and readiness recommendation.

frontend-engineer.reason: Mid — React, TypeScript, tests, and frontend logic.

frontend-polisher.reason: Mid — high-polish UI and refined interactions need better quality.

backend-engineer.reason: Mid — APIs, domain logic, and integrations.

database-engineer.reason: Mid-pro — schema design, migrations, and data integrity.

cloud-architect.reason: Mid-pro — infra, deployment, and reliability design.

test-engineer.reason: Mid — test suite creation and coverage analysis.

code-reviewer.reason: High — read-only correctness and architecture review.

security-auditor.reason: High — deep security audit for production risk.

high-engineer.reason: Mid-pro — escalation coding needs strong reasoning.

high-architect.reason: High — premium architecture and system design.

high-designer.reason: High — premium UX and product design escalation.
